{{Quote|All I'm just saying that if they're going to name a huge, over-funded, state-of-the-art army base for Fey'lya, the city named for Admiral Ackbar had better be glorious.|Voort saBinring|<ref name="Mercy Kill" />}}
'''Ackbar City''' was a settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]] in the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]], named after the legendary [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]. Located approximately twenty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] southwest of the civilian [[Unidentified Vandor-3 spaceport|spaceport]] and around forty kilometers south of the [[Borsk Fey'lya Army Base]], the settlement was a small accumulation of buildings in the middle of agricultural fields. Mostly composed of prefabricated structures, the town permitted a maximum alitutde of six meters for [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] and was in dismal condition by the time [[Wraith Squadron]] visited it in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
